profile.name: Kagiso Rabada
profile.writeup:
An unstoppable engine of lightning pace, fierce late movement, and big-stage athleticism, Kagiso Rabada stands as one of the premier fast-bowling match-winners of the modern era. Born in Johannesburg, the towering right-arm speedster pairs a clean, rhythmic run-up with explosive wrist action, routinely pushing speeds past 150 km/h with high-arm delivery angle and steep bounce. Combining relentless competitive fire with surgical technical execution, Rabada rapidly transformed from a prodigiously gifted youth star into the undisputed leader of South Africa's pace attack.


Rabada announced his arrival on the international stage with a historic One-Day International debut against Bangladesh at Dhaka in July 2015, capturing figures of 6 for 16, including a debut hat-trick that set the best bowling figures by an ODI debutant in cricket history. He earned his Test cap against India at Mohali four months later, quickly proving his ability to dismantle top orders in all conditions across the globe. Establishing himself as the youngest bowler ever to reach the top of the ICC Test bowling rankings and the youngest to claim 150 Test wickets, Rabada holds one of the most elite fast-bowling strike rates in red-ball history.


In white-ball and franchise cricket, Rabada is equally devastating, combining lethal opening spells with yorkers and deceptive change-ups during high-pressure death overs. A recipient of multiple Cricket South Africa Player of the Year awards and an IPL Purple Cap winner, he has starred for Delhi Capitals, Punjab Kings, and Gujarat Titans on the global circuit. His crowning glory as the attack's spearhead came when he helped lead South Africa to the ICC World Test Championship title, solidifying his reputation as a big-game performer who delivers under maximum pressure.


Still at the height of his powers, Rabada continues to lead the Proteas pace battery with unyielding passion and elite consistency. Respected across the cricketing world for his terrifying strike-power and quiet charisma, he remains a cornerstone of South Africa's global ambitions and an inspirational icon for fast bowlers everywhere.
